uncertainty: Water levels and islands do not define separate physical layers in this 2D candidate.
Top caps are only approximately circular/regular polygonal. Their q estimate is conditional.
Arch family span gives a different vanishing row from pillar/frog supports; median camera remains approximate.
Eight arch objects have two separate foot colliders each. Under-arch clearance versus ball size must be checked; closing the gap with one box is not assumed.
Water receiver center is the largest inscribed color patch, not a recovered basin center or volume.
Outer wall foot placement behind cascades is uncertain; shorelines were not introduced as walls.
